title.en: Credit Risk in Bond Investment — question bank v5
title.zh: 债券投资信用风险——题库第5版

source: Credit_Risk_in_Bond_Investment_Training_Deck_ICBC_v5_EN (participant questions Q1–Q6, votes D1–D3, Appendix A12 instructor questions); answers tied to Case_Ledger_v5.md

q.en: A bond has paid every coupon on time. Which losses can already have occurred?
q.zh: 一只债券每期票息都按时支付。哪些损失可能已经发生？

opts.en: None — nothing is lost until the issuer defaults
opts.zh: 没有——发行人违约前不会有任何损失

opts.en: Only losses caused by a rise in interest rates
opts.zh: 只有利率上升造成的损失

opts.en: Value, expected credit losses, sale proceeds and capital consumption can all have moved
opts.zh: 价值、预期信用损失、出售所得和资本占用都可能已经变化

why.en: Value (spread), the ECL allowance (remeasured at every reporting date), executable proceeds (liquidity) and capital can all move before any missed payment. Rates are one cause among several — and not a credit cause.
why.zh: 价值（利差）、预期信用损失准备（每个报告日重新计量）、可成交所得（流动性）和资本都可能在任何未付款之前变化。利率只是原因之一——而且不是信用原因。

q.en: Which of these three is NOT credit risk?
q.zh: 以下三项中哪一项不是信用风险？

opts.en: Benchmark interest rates rose, so the bond’s value fell
opts.zh: 基准利率上升，因此债券价值下跌

opts.en: The credit spread widened, so the bond’s value fell
opts.zh: 信用利差扩大，因此债券价值下跌

opts.en: Expected credit losses rose, so an impairment charge was booked
opts.zh: 预期信用损失上升，因此计提了减值

why.en: A benchmark-rate move is interest-rate risk — the control used to show that the same size of loss can come from a different mechanism.
why.zh: 基准利率变动属于利率风险——用作对照，说明同样规模的损失可能来自不同机制。

q.en: Huaxing’s spread widens by 100 bp; nothing else changes. Which mechanism is at work?
q.zh: 华兴利差扩大100个基点；其他不变。起作用的是哪种机制？

why.en: The benchmark has not moved and no terms have been amended. Whether the allowance (4) reacts depends on the PD estimate and the SICR judgement; liquidity (3) only if you sell.
why.zh: 基准利率未变，条款也未修改。准备（4）是否变化取决于违约概率估计和信用风险显著增加的判断；流动性（3）只在出售时体现。

q.en: Where does a bond differ most from a loan to the same obligor?
q.zh: 对同一债务人，债券与贷款最大的区别在哪里？

opts.en: Valuation and exit — a bond has a market price every day and can be sold
opts.zh: 估值与退出——债券每天都有市场价格且可以出售

why.en: Ability to pay and the need for analysis are identical; what differs is daily pricing (mechanisms 1–3 visible) and the exit; the bank cannot renegotiate bilaterally.
why.zh: 偿付能力和分析需求相同；不同的是每日定价（机制1–3可见）和退出；本行无法双边重新谈判。

q.en: A bond at amortised cost falls 6% in price on spread widening; the bank’s PD estimate for the issuer has also risen. What appears in the accounts?
q.zh: 一只按摊余成本计量的债券因利差扩大价格下跌6%；本行对发行人的违约概率估计也已上升。账上会体现什么？

opts.en: No fair-value change — but the ECL allowance is remeasured now (12-month ECL in Stage 1); it becomes lifetime ECL only if the evidence shows a significant increase in credit risk
opts.zh: 没有公允价值变动——但预期信用损失准备现在就要重新计量（第一阶段为12个月预期信用损失）；只有证据显示信用风险显著增加时，才变为整个存续期预期信用损失

why.en: No fair-value change is recognised at amortised cost. The allowance is remeasured at each reporting date (5.5.8) — a higher PD raises 12-month ECL inside Stage 1. If the spread move and the other evidence show a significant increase in credit risk (5.5.9; B5.5.17 lists spreads among the indicators), the allowance becomes lifetime ECL (5.5.3). Stage 2 is still performing.
why.zh: 摊余成本下不确认公允价值变动。准备在每个报告日重新计量（5.5.8）——违约概率上升会提高第一阶段内的12个月预期信用损失。如果利差变动及其他证据显示信用风险显著增加（5.5.9；B5.5.17将利差列为指标之一），准备变为整个存续期预期信用损失（5.5.3）。第二阶段仍属正常履约。

questions.verification: IFRS 9 as adopted by Commission Regulation (EU) 2016/2067 — https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:32016R2067 ¶¶ 4.1.2, 5.5.1–5.5.3, 5.5.5, 5.5.8, 5.5.9, B5.5.17

q.en: In ICBC’s book, where would a loss while payments continue be least visible?
q.zh: 在工行账簿中，付息持续期间的损失在哪里最不明显？

opts.en: FVOCI bonds — fair value on the balance sheet and in OCI
opts.zh: FVOCI债券——资产负债表和其他综合收益中体现公允价值

opts.en: Credit paper at amortised cost — no fair value shown; the allowance moves with PD estimates and steps up only on SICR
opts.zh: 按摊余成本计量的信用债——不显示公允价值；准备随违约概率估计变化，只有在信用风险显著增加时才跃升

why.en: For the credit slice, 36% sits at amortised cost; there deterioration reaches earnings only through ECL, modification or sale. (72% is total investments, not the credit slice.)
why.zh: 信用部分中36%按摊余成本计量；在那里，恶化只能通过预期信用损失、修改或出售影响利润。（72%是全部投资，而非信用部分。）

questions.verification: ICBC 2025 Annual Results Announcement (HKEX 27 Mar 2026), Note 50(a) — https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0327/2026032700688.pdf

q.en: Decision 1: approve the purchase at 210 bp?
q.zh: 决策1：是否批准以210个基点的利差购买？

opts.en: Approve with conditions — size, triggers, information from the branch
opts.zh: 有条件批准——规模、触发条件、来自分行的信息

why.en: Mostly B. Defensible: A (within mandate and limits), B (conditions), C (margin too thin for the information quality). Not defensible: approving without naming the exit capacity and the trigger list.
why.zh: 多数选B。可辩护：A（在授权和限额内）、B（附条件）、C（相对于信息质量，收益过薄）。不可辩护：批准时既不说明退出能力，也不列出触发条件。

q.en: Which of these gives the bank a contractual right against anyone other than Huaxing itself?
q.zh: 以下哪一项使本行对华兴以外的任何主体拥有合同权利？

opts.en: The RMB 5 bn shareholder loan of 2024
None — the bank holds a senior unsecured claim on Huaxing only
opts.zh: 都没有——本行仅对华兴持有高级无担保债权

why.en: Ownership and a past loan are facts about the shareholder, not contracts in the bank’s favour; no guarantee and no keepwell on our MTN.
why.zh: 持股和过去的贷款是关于股东的事实，而不是有利于本行的合同；我行中期票据没有担保，也没有维好协议。

q.en: Huaxing MTN, modified duration 2.80, RMB 100 m. Which costs more: the benchmark +30 bp, or the spread +30 bp?
q.zh: 华兴中期票据，修正久期2.80，1亿元。哪个损失更大：基准利率+30个基点，还是利差+30个基点？

opts.en: The same — about RMB −0.84 m each

why.en: For a fixed-rate bullet, spread duration equals modified duration: −100 × 2.80 × 0.003 = −0.84 m in both cases. Same size, different mechanism, different control.
why.zh: 对于固定利率到期一次还本的债券，利差久期等于修正久期：两种情况均为−100 × 2.80 × 0.003 = −0.84百万元。规模相同，机制不同，控制手段不同。

q.en: Spread 210 bp, LGD 60%. At what annual default rate does the spread just cover the expected loss?
q.zh: 利差210个基点，违约损失率60%。年违约率为多少时，利差恰好覆盖预期损失？

why.en: 2.10% ÷ 0.60 = 3.5% a year — a simplified break-even, not an observed or forecast PD. (1.26% is 2.10 × 0.60; 21% is 2.10 ÷ 0.10.)

q.en: Huaxing’s national-scale rating is terminated ‘at the issuer’s request’. What is this?
q.zh: 华兴的国内评级“应发行人要求”终止。这意味着什么？

opts.en: Information removed — find out why, refresh the internal rating, use it as evidence in the SICR assessment
opts.zh: 信息被移除——查明原因，更新内部评级，作为信用风险显著增加评估的证据

why.en: A termination is missing information, not a downgrade and not a trigger. It needs a reason before it changes a rating or a stage.
why.zh: 评级终止是信息缺失，不是降级，也不是触发条件。在改变评级或阶段之前需要查明原因。

q.en: Which of the dated facts is a missed payment on our MTN?
q.zh: 以下有日期的事实中，哪一项是我行中期票据的未付款？

opts.en: The 12-month extension of the two project-company trust loans
opts.zh: 两家项目公司信托贷款展期12个月

opts.en: None — every coupon on our MTN was paid; this is deterioration in information, not in payment
opts.zh: 都不是——我行中期票据每期票息都已支付；这是信息层面的恶化，而非付款层面

why.en: The trust loans are project-level debt of different legal obligors with different lenders; the CFO’s exit is governance information. Nothing on the list is a contractual shortfall on our instrument — everything is mechanisms 2, 4 and 5.
why.zh: 信托贷款是不同法律债务人、不同贷款人的项目层面债务；首席财务官离职是公司治理信息。清单上没有任何一项是我行工具的合同性短付——都属于机制2、4和5。

q.en: March 2026: benchmark +30 bp and spread +240 bp; the price falls from 100.00 to 95.07 (RMB −4.93 m). How much of it is credit repricing?
q.zh: 2026年3月：基准利率+30个基点，利差+240个基点；价格从100.00跌至95.07（−493万元）。其中多少是信用重新定价？

why.en: Sequential decomposition: reprice at 3.90% (rates only) → −0.57; then at 6.30% → a further −4.36.

q.en: Coupon received +3.60; price 100.00 → 95.07; funding cost 2.00. What is the funded return for the year?
q.zh: 收到票息+3.60；价格100.00 → 95.07；资金成本2.00。全年扣除资金成本后的收益是多少？

why.en: Gross = 3.60 − 4.93 = −1.33; funded = −1.33 − 2.00 = −3.33. Income positive, total return negative — and the issuer has paid in full.
why.zh: 总收益 = 3.60 − 4.93 = −1.33；扣除资金成本 = −1.33 − 2.00 = −3.33。收入为正，总收益为负——而发行人已足额付款。

q.en: Decision 2: on 15 March 2026, what do you do?
q.zh: 决策2：2026年3月15日，您怎么做？

opts.zh: 附有日期的触发条件持有

why.en: Most of the room holds with triggers; reduce-to-limit is also defensible. Model answer: hold with three dated triggers (refinancing plan for the September bond by 15 Aug; two monthly sales prints; any support event), watchlist entry and internal-rating refresh now, and — if the branch report arrives — a formal review with a documented SICR assessment. Not defensible: a decision without an executable price, a date and a name.
why.zh: 多数人附触发条件持有；减持至限额也可辩护。参考答案：附三个有日期的触发条件持有（8月15日前9月到期债券的再融资方案；两期月度销售数据；任何支持事件），现在列入观察名单并更新内部评级，并且——如果分行报告到达——进行正式审查并记录信用风险显著增加评估。不可辩护：没有可成交价格、日期和负责人的决策。

q.en: March 2026: price 95, early signals. Which decision is NOT defensible?
q.zh: 2026年3月：价格95，早期信号。哪项决策不可辩护？

opts.en: Hold, with a dated trigger on the September 2026 refinancing
opts.zh: 持有，并设置针对2026年9月再融资的有日期触发条件

opts.en: Reduce to the limit at the executable bid (94.37) because the position exceeds the concentration line
opts.zh: 因头寸超过集中度线，按可成交买价（94.37）减持至限额

opts.en: Sell because the price fell — without an executable price or a reason
opts.zh: 因价格下跌而卖出——没有可成交价格，也没有理由

why.en: Hold-with-trigger and reduce-to-limit both state a condition and a price. ‘Sell because it fell’ has neither: it realises the liquidity discount for no stated reason.
why.zh: 附触发条件持有和减持至限额都说明了条件和价格。“因为跌了就卖”两者都没有：它在没有说明理由的情况下实现了流动性折价。

q.en: FY2025: unrestricted cash RMB 42 bn, short-term debt RMB 98 bn. What is the ratio, and what does it say?
q.zh: 2025财年：非受限现金420亿元，短期债务980亿元。比率是多少，说明什么？

opts.zh: 0.43倍——12个月再融资需求超过现金（警报）

why.en: 42 ÷ 98 = 0.43; alarm below 1.0×. At purchase 75 ÷ 70 = 1.07×. 2.33× is the ratio upside down.

q.en: What evidence would justify believing that the shareholder will support Huaxing (counterfactual A)?
q.zh: 什么证据能证明股东会支持华兴（反事实A）？

opts.en: A press statement that ‘the shareholder stands behind the company’
opts.zh: 一则“股东支持公司”的新闻声明

opts.en: A registered guarantee or a drawn loan visible in filings — and a reading of which debt it covers
opts.zh: 在公告中可见的登记担保或已提款贷款——并弄清它覆盖哪笔债务

why.en: Ownership is a fact to analyse, not a contract; words are not evidence. Registration and cash are — and a guarantee for the new bond does not cover our MTN.
why.zh: 持股是需要分析的事实，而非合同；言辞不是证据。登记和现金才是——而为新债券提供的担保并不覆盖我行中期票据。

q.en: LGFV profile 2: weak regional finances, negative own operating cash flow, a maturity wall within 12 months, no refinancing-bond allocation. Which mechanism is the live risk while its coupons are paid?
q.zh: 城投主体2：区域财政较弱，自身经营现金流为负，12个月内集中到期，没有再融资债券额度。在其票息照常支付时，现实风险是哪种机制？

opts.en: 5 — refinancing vulnerability and weakening support, feeding the spread (2) and the ECL (4)
opts.zh: 5——再融资脆弱性和支持减弱，传导至利差（2）和预期信用损失（4）

why.en: An LGFV’s payment record can be perfect until the refinancing fails. Score the entity’s own cash flows and the region’s capacity.
why.zh: 城投的付款记录可能一直完美，直到再融资失败。要评估主体自身的现金流和区域的能力。

q.en: Our MTN (onshore parent, senior unsecured) and the group’s US$ keepwell notes (offshore SPV). Which is the stronger claim?
q.zh: 我行中期票据（境内母公司，高级无担保）与集团的美元维好票据（境外特殊目的载体）。哪个债权更强？

opts.zh: 美元票据——适用外国法律

opts.en: Our MTN — a direct claim on the operating parent; the notes sit behind every onshore creditor and rely on a deed with limited remedies
opts.zh: 我行中期票据——对经营母公司的直接债权；票据排在所有境内债权人之后，依赖救济有限的协议

why.en: Structural subordination: the SPV’s creditors reach the parent only through the deed. Founder: deeds enforceable and breached — nominal damages for those claimants.
why.zh: 结构性次级：特殊目的载体的债权人只能通过协议触及母公司。方正案：协议可执行且已被违反——这些申索人仅获名义赔偿。

questions.verification: Nuoxi Capital Ltd & Ors v Peking University Founder Group Co Ltd, [2025] HKCFA 6 — https://southsquare.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/FACV000007_2024.pdf

q.en: 15 Apr 2026, amortised cost, Stage 2: allowance 1.20 → 6.00. P&L charge for the period?
q.zh: 2026年4月15日，摊余成本，第二阶段：准备从1.20 → 6.00。本期损益费用是多少？

why.en: 6.00 − 1.20 = 4.80 for the period. Since purchase: 5.40 excluding the day-1 charge, 6.00 including it. −6.41 is the FVTPL cumulative figure; −3.60 would be the 12-month ECL had SICR not been judged (PD 6%) — the charge would then have been 2.40.
why.zh: 本期为6.00 − 1.20 = 4.80。自购买以来：不含首日费用为5.40，含首日费用为6.00。−6.41是FVTPL的累计数；−3.60是未判断信用风险显著增加时的12个月预期信用损失（违约概率6%）——那时本期费用为2.40。

q.en: 15 Apr 2026, amortised cost, Stage 2: the allowance rises from 1.20 to 6.00; since purchase from 0.60. What is the cumulative P&L charge since purchase, excluding the day-1 charge?
q.zh: 2026年4月15日，摊余成本，第二阶段：准备从1.20升至6.00；自购买以来从0.60起。不含首日费用，自购买以来累计损益费用是多少？

why.en: 6.00 − 0.60 = 5.40 (6.00 including the day-1 charge; 4.80 for the March–April period). FVOCI shows the same P&L; FVTPL shows −6.41.
why.zh: 6.00 − 0.60 = 5.40（含首日费用为6.00；3–4月期间为4.80）。FVOCI在损益中显示相同金额；FVTPL显示−6.41。

q.en: A Huaxing project company’s trust loan is extended. Does our parent MTN become non-performing?
q.zh: 华兴一家项目公司的信托贷款展期。我行持有的母公司中期票据是否变为不良？

opts.en: Not automatically — a different debtor; assess (Art. 7). The 10% rule applies to one debtor’s exposures at the bank, with an exception for recognised credit enhancement
opts.zh: 不会自动——不同债务人；需评估（第7条）。10%规则适用于同一债务人在本行的债权，经认可的增信方式除外

opts.en: Yes, because the spread is above 500 bp
opts.zh: 是，因为利差超过500个基点

why.en: The Measures propagate non-performing status within one non-retail debtor’s exposures at the bank (over 10% → all, Art. 7, exception for recognised credit enhancement) and require an assessment for other group members. Spread level is not a classification criterion.
why.zh: 《风险分类办法》在同一非零售债务人在本行的债权内传导不良状态（超过10% → 全部，第7条，经认可的增信方式除外），并要求对其他集团成员进行评估。利差水平不是分类标准。

questions.verification: 《商业银行金融资产风险分类办法》(2023年第1号) — https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2023-02/11/content_5750184.htm Art. 7

q.en: The bank first reacts in June 2026. Which control step was missed?
q.zh: 本行在2026年6月才首次作出反应。遗漏了哪个控制步骤？

opts.en: Execution — the sale was too slow
Monitoring and escalation — the December print, the CFO exit and the branch’s March information should have produced a watchlist entry and a formal review before April
opts.zh: 监测与上报——12月数据、首席财务官离职和分行3月的信息本应在4月之前促成列入观察名单和正式审查

why.en: Four steps, four dates: monitoring (Jan), escalation (Feb–Mar), formal assessment (Apr), execution (Jun). Reacting first in June skips the first two.
why.zh: 四个步骤，四个日期：监测（1月）、上报（2–3月）、正式评估（4月）、执行（6月）。到6月才首次反应，跳过了前两步。

q.en: Above what probability of support does holding beat selling today, before capital and liquidity costs?
q.zh: 在不考虑资本和流动性成本的情况下，支持概率高于多少时，持有优于今天出售？

why.en: (91.32 − 89.91) / (98.11 − 89.91) = 17.2%. The earlier 8% came from comparing June proceeds with July values and is withdrawn. With capital and liquidity costs the hurdle is somewhat higher.
why.zh: (91.32 − 89.91) / (98.11 − 89.91) = 17.2%。早先的8%来自用6月所得对比7月价值，已撤回。考虑资本和流动性成本后，门槛会更高一些。

q.en: 15 June 2026: executable bid 91.32; hold value today 98.11 if support arrives, 89.91 if not. Above what probability of support does holding beat selling (before capital and liquidity costs)?
q.zh: 2026年6月15日：可成交买价91.32；若获得支持，今日持有价值98.11，否则89.91。支持概率高于多少时持有优于出售（不考虑资本和流动性成本）？

why.en: (91.32 − 89.91) / (98.11 − 89.91) = 17.2% on one date. The earlier 8% mixed a June bid with July values.

q.en: Decision 3, 15 June 2026: hold, reduce, hedge or exit?
q.zh: 决策3，2026年6月15日：持有、减持、对冲还是退出？

why.en: Split between A and B. Model answer: B as written in the memo. Acceptable: A with the same triggers and a stated liquidity position; D if the committee states that the mandate no longer fits. Not acceptable: ‘monitor closely’; ‘sell if it falls further’; waiting for a missed payment before the credit-impaired assessment.
why.zh: A与B之间分歧。参考答案：按备忘录所写选B。可接受：A，但须有相同的触发条件并说明流动性状况；D，如委员会说明授权已不再适用。不可接受：“密切关注”；“若继续下跌就卖出”；等到未付款才做信用减值评估。

q.en: Which of these is a trigger that an auditor can test?
q.zh: 以下哪一项是审计可以检验的触发条件？

opts.en: ‘If no refinancing plan for the September bond is announced by 15 August 2026, exit the remainder at or above the stated floor by 31 August’
opts.zh: “如果2026年8月15日前未公布9月到期债券的再融资方案，则在8月31日前以不低于既定底价退出剩余部分”
“如果价格进一步下跌就卖出”

why.en: A trigger has a number or event, a date, a consequence and an owner. ‘Monitor’ has none; ‘if it falls further’ has no level, no date and no owner.
why.zh: 触发条件要有数字或事件、日期、后果和负责人。“关注”什么都没有；“若进一步下跌”没有水平、没有日期、没有负责人。

q.en: Under the weighted (standardised) approach, Huaxing’s spread doubles and its ECL rises. What happens to its risk weight today?
q.zh: 在权重法（标准法）下，华兴的利差翻倍，预期信用损失上升。其风险权重今天会怎样？

opts.en: Nothing — until default or loss of ‘investment-grade’ status (or a change of mapping); the allowance affects capital through provisions
opts.zh: 不变——直到违约或失去“投资级”地位（或映射变化）；准备通过拨备影响资本

why.en: Standardised weights react to status, not to spreads. Under IRB the higher PD raises RWA now. Capital reacts late — that is why monitoring cannot rely on it.
why.zh: 标准权重对状态作出反应，而非利差。在内部评级法下，更高的违约概率会立即提高风险加权资产。资本反应滞后——这就是监测不能依赖资本的原因。

questions.verification: 《商业银行资本管理办法》(2023年第4号) — https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202311/content_6913410.htm Arts. 67, 70, 80

q.en: Which of the nine positions can lose value only through rates and liquidity — never through issuer credit?
q.zh: 九个头寸中，哪一个只会因利率和流动性而损失价值——绝不会因发行人信用？

why.en: Sovereign RMB paper has no issuer-credit mechanism in this session (a case assumption, not a rule); it still has duration and can be illiquid in a sell-off. The controls are duration limits, not credit limits.
why.zh: 在本课程中，人民币主权债券没有发行人信用机制（这是案例假设，不是规则）；它仍有久期，在抛售中也可能缺乏流动性。控制手段是久期限额，而非信用限额。

q.en: Does the Canton of Zurich’s guarantee change how ZKB should analyse a corporate bond it buys?
q.zh: 苏黎世州的担保是否改变苏黎世州银行分析其所购公司债券的方式？

opts.en: Yes — the canton covers losses on ZKB’s investments
opts.zh: 是——州政府承担苏黎世州银行投资的损失

opts.en: No — the guarantee protects ZKB’s creditors, not the securities ZKB owns
opts.zh: 否——担保保护的是苏黎世州银行的债权人，而非其持有的证券
仅适用于瑞士法郎债券

why.en: The statutory guarantee (Cantonal Bank Act §6) covers ZKB’s liabilities. Credit risk in what ZKB owns is managed like anyone else’s; the guarantee may change risk appetite, not the analysis.
why.zh: 法定担保（《州银行法》第6条）覆盖苏黎世州银行的负债。其所持资产的信用风险与其他机构一样管理；担保可能改变风险偏好，但不改变分析。
